To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) HIV‐1 is absent in CVID; (2) HHV‐6 is present in CVID at a similar frequency to that in normal subjects.

(1) we found no evidence that HIV‐1 is implicated in the aetiology of CVID, and (2) we found no difference between CVID patients and normal subjects with respect to reactivation of HHV‐6, a virus which is known in other contexts to be associated with immunological abnormalities.
